name: Self-monitoring
items_note: Items copied from https://ipip.ori.org/newSingleConstructsKey.htm, 10 November 2026, +keyed items first as the key page lists them.

source.paper: IPIP scale measuring a construct similar to the Self-Monitoring Scale (Snyder, 1974), International Personality Item Pool

licence.text: Public domain (IPIP). Permission is granted automatically for any person to use IPIP items for any purpose, commercial or non-commercial.

instructions: Describe yourself as you generally are now, not as you wish to be in the future. Describe yourself as you honestly see yourself, in relation to other people you know of the same sex as you are, and roughly your same age.

scales.name: Self-monitoring
scales.publishedName: Self-Monitoring, IPIP scale similar to Snyder (1974)

items.text: Put on a show to impress people.
Am likely to show off if I get the chance.
Am the life of the party.
Am good at making impromptu speeches.
Hate being the center of attention.
Would not be a good comedian.
Don't like to draw attention to myself.

reliabilitySource: Coefficient alpha as given on the single-construct scoring key page, https://ipip.ori.org/newSingleConstructsKey.htm, and in the comparison table, https://ipip.ori.org/newSingleConstructs.htm, which says the IPIP and original scales were both given to the Eugene-Springfield Community Sample; accessed 10 November 2026.
